item.title: Summer Lifestyle Staples Covering Beauty Touches and Signature Scent Choices
item.description: Summer tends to reshape everyday routines in subtle but meaningful ways.

item.title: Elite 8 Bound: Lady Trojans topple Eufaula to reach region finals
item.description: Undefeated Charles Henderson dominates Eufaula 55-25 in 5A South Regional semifinal, forcing 27 turnovers to reach Elite 8 matchup with St. Paul’s.

item.title: Goshen High Black History Month Program celebrates history and future
item.description: Goshen High’s Black History Month program, themed “Black Brilliance,” honored trailblazing Black alumni and urged all students to see Black history as living, shared and still being written.

item.title: When Style Meets Meaning: Redefining your outfit!
item.description: Some pieces are chosen to complete an outfit. Others are chosen to mark a moment. Bracelets have a unique ability to do both.

item.title: Charles Henderson boys throttle Eufaula to advance to regional finals
item.description: Charles Henderson boys roll past Eufaula in the 5A South semifinal, forcing 22 turnovers to advance to a regional final rematch with LeFlore.

item.title: Troy Board of Adjustments approves signs for new McDonald’s
item.description: Troy Board of Adjustments approves sign variances for a new South Three Notch Street McDonald’s and backs an open storage structure for Sav-A-Life’s mobile unit.

item.title: Sacred Harp singing Saturday at Pioneer Museum
item.description: Annual Sacred Harp singing at the Pioneer Museum of Alabama is Saturday, 9:30 a.m.–2:30 p.m., with free admission to listen, learn or join the traditional a cappella harmony.

item.title: Alabama artists to be honored
item.description: Seven Alabama artists and arts leaders will be honored by the Alabama State Council on the Arts at the 2026 Celebration of Alabama Arts on May 14 at Alabama Shakespeare Festival.

item.title: Pugh named chamber board chair
item.description: Heritage 1843 owner Holly Pugh has been named chair of the Pike County Chamber of Commerce board, leading bi-monthly meetings as the group shifts its annual banquet from October to January.

item.title: Troy, ESCC sign new academic agreement
item.description: Troy University and Enterprise State Community College ink a 2+2 deal giving qualified ESCC mechatronics grads guaranteed entry to Troy’s new electrical and electronics engineering program.
